name: Junglecore
summary: Junglecore is an aesthetic relating to the vibrant and mysterious ways of a jungle, which is usually filled with thriving habitats for native animals, plants, waterfalls, and other jungle sightings.
description: Junglecore is an aesthetic relating to the vibrant and mysterious ways of a jungle, which is usually filled with thriving habitats for native animals, plants, waterfalls, and other jungle sightings. It can also be related to exploring, and even researching or preservation of the jungle. Junglecore is also associated with creatures such as orangutans, Indian elephants, treefrogs, leopards, and many more. It is calming and exciting, natural and bold, practical and aspirational all at the same time.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Connection with the Earth, calmness, adventuress, being bold, or down-to-earth, wildlife preservation, environmental protection, natural philosophy and conservation, ecotourism, spiritual

visualDNA.colour: Green, jungle-green, jade, bold colors, natural tones like khaki and olive

fashion.Overview: The fashion of Junglecore could be divided into two categories; the explorer and the jungle dweller.
fashion.The Jungle Explorer: The first category would be of a jungle explorer, an individual who is a visitor to the biome and is journeying through it.
fashion.The Jungle Dweller: The second category would be of someone who calls the jungle their home, and finds the jungle to be their comfort zone. Due to the prevalence of animal motifs, as well as conservation and naturalism as prominent inspiring values for the aesthetic, cruelty-free, sustainable, and synthetic faux-items may be preferred for things such as teeth, feathers, etc.

activities: An interest in botany/any tropical species
Collecting and caring for plants, especially tropical varieties
Documenting species of plants or insects
Keeping a journal of natural observations
Hiking, or taking a nature walk

sounds: Welcome to the Jungle by Guns N Roses
